purpose: expectedNpub with a BECH32M encoding of a real 32-byte key
note: MethodSpec §2.2 rule 6. Identical to original Bech32 in charset, hrp, length and payload — ONLY the checksum constant differs (0x2bc830a3 against 1). A library defaulting to Bech32m produces exactly this for a valid key, so the string is well-formed by every other measure and must still be refused
